title: Senior Software Engineer (Ai & Orchestration)
description:
Company Description


A Coru é líder em soluções de experiência de usuário para empresas, focada em desafiar o convencional por meio de sua plataforma inteligente e assistente digital ADI. Oferecemos experiências digitais humanizadas e hiperpersonalizadas, o que aumenta a geração de receita e a eficiência operacional de nossos parceiros.


Mais informações: Coru Website


Job Description


Como Senior Software Engenieer, você irá liderar a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento da nossa plataforma de orquestração de agentes de IA. A sua missão não é "reinventar a roda" no que diz respeito aos LLMs, mas sim construir uma infraestrutura robusta, escalável e flexível que integre as melhores soluções do mercado numa experiência de utilizador perfeita. Será uma peça fundamental na evolução da nossa plataforma para um orquestrador de IA de classe mundial.


Responsabilidades:


1. Arquitetura e Orquestração



  • Design do sistema: arquitetar micros serviços escaláveis e camadas de orquestração que possam lidar com vários fornecedores de IA e fluxos de trabalho complexos de agentes;

  • Estratégia de integração: avaliar e integrar serviços de IA de terceiros (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, etc.), garantindo alta disponibilidade e eficiência de custos;

  • Desenvolvimento de API: projetar e manter APIs de alto desempenho e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos para dar suporte a interações em tempo real com agentes.


2. Full-Stack Development (Node.js/React)



  • Excelência em backend: criar serviços seguros, testáveis e sustentáveis usando NestJS e TypeScript;

  • Integração de frontend: colaborar no frontend Next.js/React para garantir que resultados complexos de IA sejam apresentados de forma intuitiva para os utilizadores;

  • Gestão de bases de dados: projetar e otimizar esquemas de bases de dados relacionais (SQL) para dar suporte à gestão complexa de estados para agentes de IA.


3. Produtividade aumentada por IA



  • Fluxo de trabalho moderno: usar e defender ativamente ferramentas de desenvolvimento baseadas em IA (Cursor, GitHub Copilot) para acelerar a entrega e manter a qualidade do código.

  • Evolução contínua: manter-se atualizado sobre as ferramentas e estruturas de IA mais recentes para garantir que a nossa camada de orquestração permaneça na vanguarda.


4. Liderança e Mentoria



  • Visão técnica: fornecer orientação técnica sobre decisões de "Build vs buy" relacionadas com componentes de IA;

  • Melhores práticas: defender código limpo, CI/CD e padrões rigorosos de documentação dentro da equipa de engenharia.


Requisitos Técnicos



  • Experiência: Mais de 5 anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software;

  • Backend: Forte proficiência em Node.js e TypeScript (experiência com NestJS é uma vantagem significativa);

  • Frontend: Sólida experiência com React e Next.js;

  • Bases de dados: Conhecimento especializado em SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL ou similar);

  • Cloud & DevOps: Experiência com AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker e pipelines CI/CD modernos;

  • Ferramentas de IA: Conforto e alta proficiência na utilização de assistentes de codificação de IA (Cursor, Copilot) para aumentar a produtividade pessoal e da equipa.


Competências Essenciais



  • Mentalidade generalista: capacidade de resolver problemas em toda a pilha sem estar vinculado a um nicho específico "apenas de IA";

  • Pensamento arquitetônico: capacidade de projetar sistemas modulares e fáceis de adaptar à medida que o panorama da IA muda;

  • Orientado para resultados: focado em entregar valor ao utilizador, em vez de projetar ferramentas internas de forma excessiva.


Desejável/ Plus



  • Experiência na criação ou manutenção de fluxos de trabalho ou orquestradores Agentic;

  • Familiaridade com bases de dados vetoriais (Pinecone, Weaviate) ou arquiteturas RAG;

  • Experiência com Python (para pontes de serviço de IA específicas);

  • Compreensão da observabilidade e gestão de custos de LLM.


Você tem o perfil para ser um Coru?


Temos a convicção de que o mais importante de Coru são as pessoas, por isso é fundamental que você faça um "Fit" cultural com toda a equipe. Estes são os pilares da nossa cultura:



  • Somos Todos Líderes.

  • Rendirse jamás!

  • El único problema que no podemos resolver es aquel del que no podemos hablar.

  • All together: Diversidad de historias y vivencias. Diferentes visiones traen mayores horizontes.


Você está #TheOne?



  • Cartão de benefícios flexível Caju

  • Plano de carreira em uma empresa em rápido crescimento

  • Fazer parte de uma empresa de tecnologia que está revolucionando o mercado e melhorando a vida das pessoas em cada interação.

description:
A ERM está em busca de Consultor Assistente, para se juntar ao time de Corporate sustainability & Climate Change.

Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar projetos de consultoria na integração de temas de sustentabilidade em políticas corporativas, decisões de investimento e no desenvolvimento de produtos.
  • Realizar pesquisas sobre tendências socioambientais e climáticas e seus impactos econômicos.
  • Elaborar relatórios com os resultados de projetos de sustentabilidade e de clima.
  • Estruturar e analisar dados relacionados à sustentabilidade e ao clima, gerando conclusões e recomendações.

Perfil e Requisitos

  • Interesse em atuar (ou experiência prévia) em consultorias de gestão/sustentabilidade ou empresas com foco em clima.
  • Raciocínio analítico e familiaridade com temas socioambientais e climáticos.
  • Boa capacidade de interpretação de textos.
  • Desejável experiência com frameworks climáticos, como CDP (foco em clima), TCFD, Taxonomia da União Europeia, CBI, entre outros.
  • Inglés intermediário (desejável).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência na análise de dados e na elaboração de recomendações estratégicas.
  • Conhecimento em regulamentações relacionadas ao clima e à sustentabilidade.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.

A Environmental Resources Management (ERM) é uma fornecedora líder global de serviços de consultoria ambiental, de saúde, segurança, riscos e sociais, além de serviços relacionados à sustentabilidade. Possuímos mais de 160 escritórios em mais de 40 países e territórios, empregando mais de 5.500 pessoas que trabalham em projetos em todo o mundo. A ERM está comprometida em fornecer um serviço consistente, profissional e da mais alta qualidade para gerar valor para nossos clientes. Trabalhamos com muitas das empresas da Fortune 500 Global, fornecendo soluções inovadoras para empresas e clientes governamentais selecionados, ajudando-os a compreender e gerenciar os desafios de sustentabilidade que o mundo enfrenta cada vez mais.

Há mais de 50 anos, trabalhamos com clientes em todo o mundo e em diversos setores da indústria para ajudá-los a compreender e gerenciar seus impactos ambientais, de saúde, segurança, riscos e sociais. Os principais setores que atendemos incluem Petróleo e Gás, Mineração, Energia e Manufatura, Química e Farmacêutica. Todos enfrentam desafios críticos de sustentabilidade e nossos clientes nessas e em muitas outras áreas contam com nossa capacidade de ajudá-los a operar de forma mais sustentável, o que gera um impacto positivo em nosso planeta.

Na ERM, sabemos que criar um ambiente de trabalho diverso, equitativo e inclusivo é parte essencial para tornar nossa empresa um ótimo lugar para construir uma carreira.

Se você deseja ler mais sobre Diversidade, Equidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento (DEIB) na ERM, você pode visitar nosso site ou ler sobre nosso progresso no Relatório de Sustentabilidade de 2024.

title: FISIOTERAPEUTA - [BANCO DE TALENTOS]
description:
Há 88 anos, a Fundação José Silveira mantém o olhar voltado para o futuro, reinventando suas práticas em um mundo imprevisível, sem perder de vista suas raízes sólidas naquilo que é a origem do propósito: cuidar da saúde e melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

Com isso, buscamos pessoas conectadas ao novo que venham contribuir com o constante crescimento e a perpetuação do nosso legado.

Junte-se ao nosso propósito!

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar avaliação, diagnóstico funcional fisioterapêutico e execução do plano terapêutico do paciente crítico (de alta complexidade);
  • Participar das visitas multidisciplinares diárias;
  • Aplicar métodos, técnicas e recursos de expansão pulmonar, remoção de secreções brônquicas, fortalecimento muscular, recondicionamento cardiorrespiratório e suporte ventilatório do paciente crítico ou potencialmente crítico;
  • Reformular o programa terapêutico sempre que necessário;
  • Registrar no prontuário do cliente, as prescrições fisioterapêuticas, sua evolução, as intercorrências e as condições de alta da assistência fisioterapêutica;
  • Realizar posicionamento no leito, cinesioterapia, sedesia, deambulação, além de planejar e executar ações de adaptação, readaptação, orientação e capacitação dos pacientes, visando a maior funcionalidade do mesmo;
  • Analisar aspectos clínicos gerais, sensório‑motoras, percepto‑cognitivas e socioculturais dos pacientes para traçar plano terapêutico;
  • Estimular a percepção tátil‑cinestésica, reeducar a postura dos pacientes, sugerir a aquisição e/ou adaptação de órteses e próteses, acompanhando a evolução terapêutica do paciente;
  • Realizar transferências (passagem do paciente do leito para a cadeira de rodas e supervisionar a deambulação com uso de andador e muletas);
  • Participar da realização de curativos atuando na prevenção de sequelas motoras;
  • Compartilhar gerencialmente da ventilação mecânica, desmame da ventilação, extubação, ventilação não‑invasiva;
  • Orientar e encaminhar pacientes para unidades de referência para continuidade de tratamento especializado sistemático;
  • Participar da confecção de protocolo assistenciais e procedimentos operacionais padrão, que subsidiam e sistematizam as técnicas assistenciais.

Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Fisioterapia;
  • Experiência na área hospitalar;
  • Desejável especialização na área de saúde;
  • Disponibilidade para escala 12x36h.

Criada em 21 de fevereiro de 1937 pelo Professor José Silveira, a Fundação José Silveira (FJS) vem ampliando sua obra em um processo de crescimento sustentável, firmado no planejamento estratégico e foco nos melhores resultados. Instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos, a Fundação José Silveira atende principalmente a população mais desassistida, com qualidade nos serviços prestados.

É o que demonstra o trabalho de referência das nossas unidades em áreas como combate à tuberculose, assistência neonatal, parto humanizado, tratamento do câncer de mama e reabilitação de pacientes com deficiências neuropsicomotoras, intelectuais e autismo. Por ano, são mais de 1,2 milhão de atendimentos realizados. A FJS promove, ainda, ações de prevenção e promoção da saúde e socioambientais voltadas às comunidades de Salvador e de municípios do interior da Bahia, contribuindo para a melhoria dos indicadores sociais e de saúde no estado.

description:
Há 88 anos, a Fundação José Silveira mantém o olhar voltado para o futuro, reinventando suas práticas em um mundo imprevisível, sem perder de vista suas raízes sólidas naquilo que é a origem do propósito: cuidar da saúde e melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

Com isso, buscamos pessoas conectadas ao novo que venham contribuir com o constante crescimento e a perpetuação do nosso legado.

Junte-se ao nosso propósito!

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar avaliação terapêutica ocupacional;
  • Executar atendimento individual (incluindo pacientes em isolamento) e em grupo;
  • Promover desempenho ocupacional e capacidade funcional;
  • Efetuar estimulação dos aspectos cognitivos e sensoperceptivos;
  • Realizar treino de atividades da vida diária (AVD);
  • Confeccionar órteses e adaptações;
  • Promover socialização e humanização hospitalar;
  • Realizar oficinas terapêuticas;
  • Atender e orientar a família do paciente;

Qualificações

  • Formação superior completo em Terapeuta Ocupacional
  • Experiência na área hospitalar;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em escala de 12x36h.

Criada em 21 de fevereiro de 1937 pelo Professor José Silveira, a Fundação José Silveira (FJS) vem ampliando sua obra em um processo de crescimento sustentável, firmado no planejamento estratégico e foco nos melhores resultados. Instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos, a Fundação José Silveira atende principalmente a população mais desassistida, com qualidade nos serviços prestados.

É o que demonstra o trabalho de referência das nossas unidades em áreas como combate à tuberculose, assistência neonatal, parto humanizado, tratamento do câncer de mama e reabilitação de pacientes com deficiências neuropsicomotoras, intelectuais e autismo. Por ano, são mais de 1,2 milhão de atendimentos realizados. A FJS promove, ainda, ações de prevenção e promoção da saúde e socioambientais voltadas às comunidades de Salvador e de municípios do interior da Bahia, contribuando para a melhoria dos indicadores sociais e de saúde no estado.

title: Operation Lead (3x2 Day Shift), TOM - Transportation Operation Management
description:
Job ID: | Amazon Servicos de Varejo do Brasil Ltda.

A ATS (Amazon Transportation Services) está procurando por pessoas motivadas para ajudar a desenvolver um processo logístico de classe mundial que entregue mercadorias no prazo e com o melhor custo. O objetivo da nossa equipe é gerenciar com excelência a execução do transporte que flui através de nossas redes de operações logísticas, focada especificamente na segurança, qualidade e desempenho das transportadoras e dos processos.

Esse papel exige por uma pessoa ambiciosa. Você representará uma função crítica em nossas operações de transporte, trabalhando para melhorar continuamente os níveis de serviço, enquanto prezava a segurança em nossas instalações. Isso nos ajudará a garantir que as promessas feitas aos nossos valiosos clientes sejam cumpridas sempre.

Uma pessoa especialista em operações de transporte facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas (transportadoras/hubs/armazéns) e resolve quaisquer possíveis problemas que afetem a experiência do cliente e a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, trabalhará em operações externas com relacionamento Sort Center/Carrier, garantindo que os veículos saiam do SC para entregar os pedidos dos clientes conforme a promessa. Essa pessoa também monitora a chegada da nossa frota e aborda quaisquer possíveis problemas que ocorram durante o ciclo completo do transporte de middle mile, entre as operações Amazon.

Como especialista em transporte, você será desafiado a solucionar problemas em tempo hábil, pesquisando e consultando ferramentas internas e tomando decisões em tempo real. Você deve ser capaz de entender os requisitos e analisar dados, observando tendências e ser capaz de impulsionar a experiência do cliente sem comprometer o tempo. Ter o conhecimento básico de Logística, se comunicar claramente na forma escrita e oral, também é necessário. Idealizar melhorias no processo e ter o zelo de levá-las à conclusão.

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não só celebramos a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, mas também as diversas formas de trabalhar.

Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para o processo de entrevista ou integração, informe nossa equipe e nós o conectaremos à nossa equipe de acomodação.

Essa função funcionará em turnos 3x2 das 6h às 18h.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Interação constante com diversos clientes externos (transportadoras, fornecedores etc) e clientes internos (WHS, Planejamento, Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers Delivery Stations etc).
  • Capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados, usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados, para elaborar relatórios e análises conforme a necessidade.
  • Compreender e desenvolver as métricas de desempenho da equipe, buscando contribuir na manutenção e impulsionamento dos resultado.
  • Deve ser capaz de entender rapidamente o impact comercial das tendências e tomar decisões que façam sentido com base nos dados disponíveis.
  • Deve ser capaz de encaminhar sistematicamente problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes e cumprir as resoluções para garantir que sejam entregues.
  • Trabalhar com as várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, ao mesmo tempo em que mede e identifica as atividades realizadas.
  • Excelente comunicação, tanto verbal quanto escrita, para criar uma narrativa descrevendo as descobertas semanais e as variações das metas, e apresentá-las em um fórum de revisão.
  • Suporta o monitoramento da chegada de veículos, correta alocação de veículos no horário necessário para carregamento, nas docas corretas, respeitando todos os padrões de segurança Amazon.
  • Responder às atividades de agendamento de veículos.
  • Prioriza e define a alocação dos veículos em doca.

A Day in the Life

O Ops Lead é o principal ponto de contato de transportes dentro de um centro de distribuição/ sort center. Ele(a) será o guardião de segurança e qualidade em todas as movimentações de Inbound e Outbound dentro das instalações Amazon. Garantirá a execução da rotina e a exelência nos resultados das métricas. Analisará qualquer desvio, mesmo que pequeno, para evitar problemas de qualidade e segurança. Escalará pontenciais riscos de atendimento para a liderança, e garantirá o fluxo de entrada e saída de veículos sem gargalos.

Qualifications

  • Ensino Superior Completo.
  • Inglês em nível intermediário.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise de qualidade (5 Porquês, Análise de pareto, Ishikawa, etc.).

A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and more than 1800 employees in 50+ countries. title: Global Process Data Consultant/Lead
description:
Job Description :

Global Process Data Consultant / Lead Duration : 7 months

100% Remote opportunity within USA and Brazil

Position Purpose

Currently undertaking several large-scale global transformation projects. Each of which requires conversion and migration of data, and ongoing process (reference, conditional, configuration, transactional, and etc..) data management. We are seeking experienced SAP S / 4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield S / 4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business processes. This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose, standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build, migration, and adoption.

The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.

Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

  • Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements aligned to standardized value stream processes.
  • Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data definitions for S / 4HANA.
  • Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and hierarchies across geographies.
  • Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return) Functional Process.

Data Ownership Responsibilities

  • Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.
  • Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.
  • Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.

Data Migration & Readiness

  • Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.
  • Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S / 4HANA.
  • Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.
  • Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.

Data Governance & Standards

  • Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.
  • Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.
  • Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.
  • Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.
  • Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.
  • Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.
  • Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.
  • Hands‑on experience with SAP S / 4HANA (greenfield preferred).
  • Proven involvement in large‑scale, global ERP implementations.
  • Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.
  • Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.

Technical & Functional Skills

  • Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.g., Material, Vendor / Business Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).
  • Understanding of S / 4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.
  • Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.
  • Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).
  • Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.

Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work across global, cross‑functional teams.
  • Detail‑oriented with strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast‑paced transformation environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset‑intensive industries.
  • Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.
  • Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.
  • Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.

title: Business Analyst & Scrum Master (Supply Chain)
description:
We are seeking a Hybrid Business Analyst & Scrum Master to support the delivery of Supply Chain Analytics product teams . This role combines deep business and data analysis expertise with Agile leadership to drive insights, improve supply chain performance, and ensure predictable, high-quality delivery.

The successful candidate will partner with planning, logistics, manufacturing, and analytics stakeholders , translating business needs into actionable analytics solutions while facilitating Scrum ceremonies and team execution.

Key Responsibilities

Product & Business Analysis (80%)

  • Partner with Supply Chain stakeholders across Demand Planning, S&OP, Logistics, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Customer Service to gather and define requirements.
  • Translate business problems into analytics solutions including dashboards, KPIs, data marts, and alerts , aligned to the product roadmap.
  • Create and maintain analysis artifacts: user stories, acceptance criteria, BPMN process maps, data dictionaries, and data lineage .
  • Perform data discovery and profiling in Snowflake ; write optimized SQL (CTEs, window functions) and validate data quality against source systems.
  • Review Power BI reports, semantic models, DAX measures , calculation groups, and Row-Level Security (RLS) .
  • Define, monitor, and improve key supply chain KPIs such as forecast accuracy, inventory turns, OTIF, case fill rate, production adherence, DC throughput, and transportation cost per case .
  • Support data governance initiatives including metadata management, access controls, and data quality rules.
  • Contribute to analytics standards, best practices, and documentation.

Scrum Master & Delivery (20%)

  • Serve as Scrum Master for the analytics product team.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies: daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives .
  • Coach teams on Agile principles including transparency, inspection, and iterative delivery .
  • Maintain backlog health and sprint cadence; leverage velocity, cycle time, and burn metrics to forecast delivery.
  • Remove impediments and foster collaboration across business, data engineering, analytics, platform, and security teams .
  • Promote Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) , test automation where applicable, and measurable sprint outcomes.
  • Communicate progress through roadmaps, dashboards, and stakeholder updates.

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in Business Analysis or Analytics roles.
  • 3–5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake, SQL, and Power BI (DAX, RLS, data modeling).
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data quality frameworks .
  • Experience in CPG supply chain domains (demand planning, inventory, production, logistics).
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications: CSM / PSM , PL-300 , SnowPro Core
  • Experience with SAP, Blue Yonder, or Kinaxis
  • Knowledge of S&OP, APS, ERP (SAP ECC/S4), TMS, and WMS data structures and integrations
  • Familiarity with data governance frameworks (stewardship, cataloging, quality rules)
  • Snowflake, SQL
  • Power BI (Desktop & Service)
  • Data Catalog / Governance tools (e.g., Collibra)
  • ERP / APS / TMS / WMS integrations

Business Impact

  • Improve service levels, inventory turns, forecast accuracy, and cost-to-serve .

description:
Data Architect with AWS & Snowflake experience

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership : Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.
  • End-to-End Ownership : Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.
  • Orchestration and Automation : Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.
  • Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization : Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.
  • Real-Time and Batch Processing : Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.
  • Data Governance and Security : Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.
  • Scalability and Performance : Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.
  • Team Building : Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement : Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills :

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.
  • Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.
  • Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.
  • Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.
  • Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.
  • Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.
  • Strong understanding of CI / CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.
  • Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.
  • Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills :

  • Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.
  • Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.
  • Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.
  • Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills :

  • Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: Head Of Finance, Brazil
description:
CONMED Corporation is a progressive, global medical device company, operating in 20 countries. Through thoughtful leadership, innovation and teamwork, we are changing the future of healthcare. Our 3,500 employees worldwide make meaningful contributions, positively impact the business, and advance in their careers as our company and product portfolio grows. We are a leader in Orthopedics, General Surgery, Gynecology, Gastroenterology, Pulmonology, and Anesthesiology and our employees enjoy challenging and diverse job opportunities across these varied specializations. CONMED is headquartered in the United States. Our international presence includes more than 20 locations throughout Canada, Europe, Australia, Latin America, Asia, North America, and the Middle East.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Finance Director for Brazil is responsible for leading all financial operations, ensuring full compliance with local regulations, strengthening internal controls, optimizing financial performance, developing and supporting strategic business objectives. This role is pivotal in elevating governance, audit readiness, and operational discipline across the Brazilian organization.

This role oversees FP&A, Controllership, Reporting, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Internal Controls, Compliance, and Financial Governance, while partnering closely with the Country Manager and regional / global Finance leadership to drive sustainable growth, profitability, strong governance and disciplined execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic & Financial Leadership

Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with corporate objectives and Brazil's dynamic economic and regulatory environment.

Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, cash planning, and long‑range planning processes for Brazil.

Serve as a strategic partner to the Country Manager and senior leadership team, providing actionable insights to influence commercial, operational, and organizational decisions.

Monitor market trends, FX volatility, reimbursement dynamics, inflationary pressures, and competitor behavior to inform financial strategy.

Financial Reporting, Compliance & Audit Readiness

Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely reporting under Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate accounting standards (including US GAAP, if applicable).

Ensure complete, timely, and compliant statutory reporting, tax filings, SPED obligations (ECD / ECF), and other regulatory submissions.

Lead the Brazil Audit Remediation Plan, ensuring closure of all audit findings (high / medium / low risk) within established timelines.

Strengthen governance, documentation discipline, and financial process transparency to achieve "audit‑ready, always" standards.

Manage external relationships with auditors (Big 4), tax authorities, banks, and regulatory bodies, representing the company with professionalism and financial rigor.

Treasury, Cash Flow & Working Capital Management

Own end‑to‑end cash flow, liquidity planning, and working capital performance (AR, AP, inventory).

Lead banking relationships, credit facility management, financial instruments, FX operations, and covenant monitoring.

Optimize capital structure, credit utilization, hedging strategies, and funding needs in alignment with corporate Treasury.

Drive improvements in collections, DSO, inventory turns, and payment terms to enhance cash generation.

Performance Management & Business Partnering

Deliver comprehensive financial analysis, including P&L performance, balance sheet quality, KPI trends, pricing, and margin enhancement opportunities.

Evaluate commercial strategies, business cases, investments, and distributor economics across franchises, customers, and Brazil geographies.

Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to improve pricing governance, cost‑to‑serve, product mix optimization, and portfolio profitability.

Internal Controls, Governance & Risk Management

Design, implement, and continuously strengthen internal controls aligned with SOX, corporate governance frameworks, and Brazilian regulatory requirements.

Lead governance of Fixed‑asset tracking and mobility controls, Inventory accuracy, reconciliations, and reporting reliability (including 3PL and distributor consignment).

Build and maintain a comprehensive risk register, governance cadence, and audit calendar.

Systems, ERP & Digital Finance

Lead optimization and governance of ERP and reporting systems, improving data integrity, and reporting accuracy.

Implement analytics and BI tools to enhance management dashboards, forecasting, and business decision‑making.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead, mentor, and develop a high‑performing Finance organization across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and Controls.

Build strong bench strength and raise capability in financial governance, technical accounting, tax, and analytics.

Lead the team through transformational change, strengthening culture, accountability, and execution discipline.

Foster effective cross‑functional partnerships with Operations, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Service teams.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

Minimum 7–10 years in senior finance leadership roles (Finance Director, Country Controller, CFO, or equivalent) within multinational environments.

Proven experience in a similar leadership role or demonstrated potential to successfully assume such responsibilities.

Proven track record in governance turnarounds, internal controls design, and complex compliance environments.

Significant experience managing cash flow, working capital, treasury, and banking relationships.

Demonstrated expertise in Accounting, FP&A, Tax (including indirect taxes), Treasury, and statutory reporting.

Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or medical devices preferred; understanding of distributors and regulated markets is a plus.

Deep understanding of Brazil's financial, tax, and regulatory landscape.

Strong command of Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate reporting frameworks including US GAAP.

Advanced analytical thinking with ability to translate data into insights and influence senior decision‑makers.

Strong systems orientation, with hands‑on ERP experience (SAP / Oracle) and BI / reporting tools.

Exceptional communication skills in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken.

Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive accountability, lead change, and elevate organizational capability.

High degree of integrity, assertiveness, discipline, and ownership in managing financial governance.

Education & Credentials

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (required).

MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Controllership, or related field (preferred).

Professional certification such as CRC, CPA, CMA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

Additional credentials in internal controls, audit, or compliance are a plus.

description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Hybrid Business Analyst & Scrum Master to support the delivery of Supply Chain Analytics product teams. This role combines deep business and data analysis expertise with Agile leadership to drive insights, improve supply chain performance, and ensure predictable, high-quality delivery.

The successful candidate will partner with planning, logistics, manufacturing, and analytics stakeholders, translating business needs into actionable analytics solutions while facilitating Scrum ceremonies and team execution.

Key Responsibilities

Product & Business Analysis (80%)

Partner with Supply Chain stakeholders across Demand Planning, S&OP, Logistics, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Customer Service to gather and define requirements.

Translate business problems into analytics solutions including dashboards, KPIs, data marts, and alerts, aligned to the product roadmap.

Create and maintain analysis artifacts: user stories, acceptance criteria, BPMN process maps, data dictionaries, and data lineage.

Perform data discovery and profiling in Snowflake; write optimized SQL (CTEs, window functions) and validate data quality against source systems.

Review Power BI reports, semantic models, DAX measures, calculation groups, and Row-Level Security (RLS).

Define, monitor, and improve key supply chain KPIs such as forecast accuracy, inventory turns, OTIF, case fill rate, production adherence, DC throughput, and transportation cost per case.

Support data governance initiatives including metadata management, access controls, and data quality rules.

Contribute to analytics standards, best practices, and documentation.

Scrum Master & Delivery (20%)

Serve as Scrum Master for the analytics product team.

Facilitate Agile ceremonies: daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

Coach teams on Agile principles including transparency, inspection, and iterative delivery.

Maintain backlog health and sprint cadence; leverage velocity, cycle time, and burn metrics to forecast delivery.

Remove impediments and foster collaboration across business, data engineering, analytics, platform, and security teams.

Promote Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD), test automation where applicable, and measurable sprint outcomes.

Communicate progress through roadmaps, dashboards, and stakeholder updates.

Required Qualifications

5–8+ years of experience in Business Analysis or Analytics roles.

3–5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master.

Strong hands‑on experience with Snowflake, SQL, and Power BI (DAX, RLS, data modeling).

Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data quality frameworks.

Experience in CPG supply chain domains (demand planning, inventory, production, logistics).

Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Certifications: CSM/PSM, PL-300, SnowPro Core

Experience with SAP, Blue Yonder, or Kinaxis

Knowledge of S&OP, APS, ERP (SAP ECC/S4), TMS, and WMS data structures and integrations

Familiarity with data governance frameworks (stewardship, cataloging, quality rules)

Snowflake, SQL

Power BI (Desktop & Service)

Data Catalog/Governance tools (e.g., Collibra)

ERP/APS/TMS/WMS integrations

Business Impact

Improve service levels, inventory turns, forecast accuracy, and cost-to-serve.

Increase analytics reliability, scalability, and stakeholder adoption.

Descrição da vaga

Role Overview

We are seeking a Hybrid Business Analyst & Scrum Master to support the delivery of Supply Chain Analytics product teams . This role combines deep business and data analysis expertise with Agile leadership to drive insights, improve supply chain performance, and ensure predictable, high-quality delivery.

The successful candidate will partner with planning, logistics, manufacturing, and analytics stakeholders , translating business needs into actionable analytics solutions while facilitating Scrum ceremonies and team execution.

Key Responsibilities

Product & Business Analysis (80%)

  • Partner with Supply Chain stakeholders across Demand Planning, S&OP, Logistics, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Customer Service to gather and define requirements.
  • Translate business problems into analytics solutions including dashboards, KPIs, data marts, and alerts , aligned to the product roadmap.
  • Create and maintain analysis artifacts: user stories, acceptance criteria, BPMN process maps, data dictionaries, and data lineage .
  • Perform data discovery and profiling in Snowflake ; write optimized SQL (CTEs, window functions) and validate data quality against source systems.
  • Review Power BI reports, semantic models, DAX measures , calculation groups, and Row-Level Security (RLS) .
  • Define, monitor, and improve key supply chain KPIs such as forecast accuracy, inventory turns, OTIF, case fill rate, production adherence, DC throughput, and transportation cost per case .
  • Support data governance initiatives including metadata management, access controls, and data quality rules.
  • Contribute to analytics standards, best practices, and documentation.

Scrum Master & Delivery (20%)

  • Serve as Scrum Master for the analytics product team.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies: daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives .
  • Coach teams on Agile principles including transparency, inspection, and iterative delivery .
  • Maintain backlog health and sprint cadence; leverage velocity, cycle time, and burn metrics to forecast delivery.
  • Remove impediments and foster collaboration across business, data engineering, analytics, platform, and security teams .
  • Promote Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) , test automation where applicable, and measurable sprint outcomes.
  • Communicate progress through roadmaps, dashboards, and stakeholder updates.

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in Business Analysis or Analytics roles.
  • 3–5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake, SQL, and Power BI (DAX, RLS, data modeling).
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data quality frameworks .
  • Experience in CPG supply chain domains (demand planning, inventory, production, logistics).
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Data Engineer to enhance the resilience and operational stability of our data pipelines, from factory floor to cloud repositories. This critical role will focus on building robust monitoring and support systems, and on accelerating our ability to understand and resolve system and pipeline breakdowns.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and integrate production support technologies and systems to improve data pipeline reliability.

Knowledge and Technical Competencies

Soft skills: Organized, proactive, curious, sense of urgency and prioritization, and a strong feeling of ownership.

Technical expertise: Proven experience in systems support, data pipelines, database reliability engineering, and IT production support. Strong background in designing and implementing monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions.

Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL (queries) and a scripting language (e.g., Python) for data analysis and automation. Hands‑on experience with GCP data technologies (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow) and monitoring tools (e.g., Grafana, Cloud Monitoring). Familiarity with business intelligence tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI, Tableau) for dashboarding.

Desired qualifications: Knowledge of process industry KPIs. Familiarity with data governance platforms (e.g., Collibra) and data transformation tools (e.g., Dataform). Multilingual English / Spanish / Portuguese would be a plus. Experience with Production Support would be a plus.

Background: Degree in Engineering or Computer Science.

Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.

Missão do cargo

O que é sucesso em 6–12 meses

  • Fluxo de caixa e projeções confiáveis (curto/médio prazo) e visão de runway

Estamos entrando em um ciclo de escala em que o financeiro deixa de ser "rotina" e passa a ser motor de previsibilidade, governança e crescimento eficiente.

Buscamos uma pessoa sênior, mão na massa e cabeça de dono, que queira construir uma trilha real para se tornar líder de Finanças / Controller / futuro CFO nos próximos anos, ajudando a elevar:

  • Governança e disciplina financeira (ritual de números, políticas, controles, compliance)
  • Eficiência e unit economics (margem, CAC, payback, LTV, churn, NRR)
  • Finanças conectadas ao PLG (billing, receitas, cobrança, precificação, métricas de expansão)

Principais responsabilidades

  1. 1) Operação financeira com padrão de excelência
    • Contas a pagar / receber ponta a ponta (agendamentos, conciliações, cobrança, régua de recebimento)
    • Emissão e conferência de NFs (saída / entrada) e organização documental
    • Gestão de contratos e cadastros no ERP / CRM, garantindo consistência de dados
    • Interface com contabilidade (fechamento mensal, lançamentos, provisões, impostos, obrigações)
  2. 2) Controladoria digital e governança
    • Estruturar e manter rotina de fechamento (checklists, prazos, conciliações, provisões)
    • Criar e evoluir DRE gerencial, por produto / linha quando aplicável, com análise de variações
    • Implementar controles internos: política de despesas, alçadas, centros de custo, reembolsos, viagens
    • Apoiar o desenho de processos para auditoria, compliance e governança (mesmo em estágio early)
  3. 3) FP&A (planejamento e performance)
    • Construir e atualizar orçamento, forecast e cenários (base / agressivo / conservador)
    • Gestão de caixa com visão de curto / médio prazo (projeções, riscos, decisões de alocação)
    • Acompanhar indicadores de eficiência: margem, burn, runway, produtividade por área, custo por canal
  4. 4) Finanças conectadas ao PLG (SaaS)
    • Apoiar e evoluir o processo de billing e receita (cobrança recorrente, upgrades, renovações, inadimplência)
    • Acompanhar métricas SaaS em conjunto com RevOps / CS / Produto: MRR/ARR, churn, NRR, expansão, cohort
    • Dar suporte a decisões de precificação e embalagem (impacto em margem, conversão, retenção e NRR)
    • Garantir qualidade do dado financeiro que alimenta PLG (ex.: receita por plano, descontos, payback por segmento)
  5. 5) Melhoria contínua e automação
    • Mapear gargalos e automatizar rotinas com ERP, integrações e planilhas inteligentes
    • Padronizar relatórios e criar dashboards com consistência (financeiro + operação)
    • Sugerir melhorias de processo com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade

Requisitos

  • Residir na Grande Florianópolis (modelo híbrido) ou na Região Sul, com disponibilidade para encontros presenciais mensais em Florianópolis.
  • Formação em Administração, Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida (ideal 4–8+ anos) em finanças / controladoria em ambiente dinâmico.
  • Vivência com fechamento mensal, conciliações, provisões e interface contábil.
  • Domínio de Excel / Google Sheets e boa capacidade analítica.
  • Perfil de autonomia, organização, priorização e responsabilidade por entregas.

Diferenciais que valorizamos muito

  • Vivência com Omie (ou ERPs similares) e integrações (Zapier / n8n / BI).
  • Noções de revenue recognition / competência e organização de contratos recorrentes.

Nice to Have:

InComm is global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.

About This Opportunity

As a Product Owner, you will work closely with both our Business Intelligence and Reporting Teams. In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.

The ideal candidate will have experience with Scrum/ Agile processes, Accounting/Financial Systems, SSRS, PowerBI, and Tableau. Knowledge of ETL and Oracle/Oracle EBS is a plus.

Professional English Language skills are required. Position is CLT and fully remote (must reside in Brazil). Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for Internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!

Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Finance & Accounting leadership and BI teams on product backlog and coordinate with various technology teams across InComm to implement new solutions.
  • Build, manage and prioritize product backlog based on the overall strategy and business objectives for future product development.
  • Responsible for creating and/or managing following artifacts:
    • Road Map
    • Development Backlog
    • User Stories and Sprint Tasks
    • Supporting documents for user stories
  • Monitor and Review ServiceNow (SNOW) requests
  • Create product vision and roadmap which accomplishes the goal of the vision and convey that vision to the scrum team.
  • Ensure user stories are well defined and ready for development to begin.
  • Responsible for optimizing the value of the work done.
  • Accountable for each stage of the development process and the final product.
  • Ensure close collaboration with development team. Be available to address any questions team members have regarding requirements or implementation of a product feature.
  • Responsible for communicating with stakeholders across the board, including product managers, leadership, customers, and the development team to make sure their vision is aligned with business objectives.

Preferred Qualifications/Experience

  • Experience with reporting and operations within Billing, Accounting, and Sales
  • Experience working in Agile/Technical environments
  • Skilled in and comfortable working alongside technical stakeholders, translating business needs into clear, actionable inputs for development or support teams.
  • Proficient in Agile/Scrum
  • Agile/Scrum Certification
  • General knowledge of ERP, Databases (Oracle & MS SQL) and Data Lakes is a plus
  • SRS, PowerBI, Tableau and knowledge of ETL.

Com uma rede de 24 lojas físicas e um dinâmico Canal Digital , o Grupo Facell conecta pessoas em 3 estados vibrantes do Nordeste : Ceará, Bahia e Rio Grande do Norte. Nossa equipe, com mais de 300 talentos , é o coração do nosso sucesso.

Nosso compromisso é claro: equipar você para alcançar resultados extraordinários.

Nosso Legado, Seu Propósito

  • Missão: Há mais de duas décadas, promovemos experiências transformadoras em tecnologia e conectividade para nossos clientes.
  • Visão: Consolidamos nossa posição como número 1 em qualidade e produtividade na Tim Nordeste, e continuamos a mirar o futuro com a mesma ambição.
  • Valores: Nosso alicerce é o compromisso inabalável com a excelência no atendimento, o foco em resultados que impulsionam o crescimento, o investimento contínuo no desenvolvimento humano, a humildade que nos mantém conectados e a energia contagiante que nos move.
  • Negócio: Em mais de 20 anos, construímos a reputação de oferecer sempre a melhor escolha, tanto para nossos clientes quanto para nossa equipe.

Seu Próximo Capítulo Começa Aqui!

O Grupo Facell te convida a fazer parte de uma história de sucesso com mais de duas décadas de impacto. Se você busca mais do que um emprego – busca um lugar onde sua paixão e talento serão valorizados, onde os desafios se convertem em oportunidades e onde sua jornada profissional terá um legado duradouro – nossas portas estão abertas para você!

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.

Duties and Responsibilities

User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design

Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.

Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.

Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.

Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.

User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution

Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.

Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.

Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.

Data Product Development

Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.

Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.

Implement and manage MLOps and CI / CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.

Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.

Collaboration and Implementation

Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.

Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.

Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

  • UX / UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.

Requirements

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI / Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands‑on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high‑end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.

Nice-to-haves

  • AI / ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI / ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front‑end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.

Credentials and Experience

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands‑on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX / UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast‑paced technology or SaaS environment.

Benefits

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.

Duties and Responsibilities

User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design

Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.

Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.

Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.

Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.

User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution

Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.

Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.

Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.

Data Product Development

Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.

Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.

Implement and manage MLOps and CI / CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.

Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.

Collaboration and Implementation

Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.

Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.

Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

  • UX / UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.

Requirements

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI / Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands‑on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high‑end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.

Nice-to-haves

  • AI / ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI / ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front‑end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.

Credentials and Experience

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands‑on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX / UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast‑paced technology or SaaS environment.

Benefits

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.

Duties and Responsibilities

User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design

Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.

Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.

Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.

Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.

User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution

Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.

Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.

Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.

Data Product Development

Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.

Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.

Implement and manage MLOps and CI / CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.

Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.

Collaboration and Implementation

Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.

Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.

Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

  • UX / UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.

Requirements

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI / Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands‑on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high‑end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.

Nice-to-haves

  • AI / ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI / ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front‑end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.

Credentials and Experience

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands‑on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX / UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast‑paced technology or SaaS environment.

Benefits

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

  • Experiência comprovada em AWS, incluindo pelo menos alguns destes serviços: API Gateway, Lambda, ECS, Fargate ou equivalentes de orquestração/containerização.
  • Vivência com ambientes de produção: monitoramento básico, logs, versionamento de modelos ou pipelines, boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Inglês intermediário: capaz de ler documentação técnica e escrever mensagens/PRs em inglês, quando necessário.
  • Formação completa em Ciência/Engenharia da Computação, Data Science, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Ter alguns anos de experiência (ou equivalente em projetos intensivos) trabalhando com dados, ML ou desenvolvimento de software em ambiente profissional.

DIFERENCIAIST

  • Ter colocado em produção soluções envolvendo LLMs e/ou agentes de IA (projetos profissionais ou autorais bem estruturados).
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código (por exemplo, Terraform).
  • Familiaridade com MLOps (tracking de experimentos, versionamento de modelos/datasets, CI/CD para ML).
  • Participação ativa em code reviews, definição de padrões de código e documentação técnica.
  • Perfil mão na massa, com autonomia, responsabilidade sobre entregas e grande vontade de aprender novas tecnologias.

COMO TRABALHAMOS

Modelo híbrido para São Paulo (capital) ou remoto (demais localidades).

Regime PJ, com atuação em tempo mínimo de 40 horas semanais. Horário flexível, com foco em resultados, mas é importante ter disponibilidade para participar de reuniões de alinhamento e colaboração com o time. Ambiente colaborativo, com cultura forte de mentoria, trocas técnicas frequentes e aprendizado contínuo.

QUER FAZER PARTE?

Envie seu currículo, portfólio (GitHub, artigos, projetos, etc.) e pretensão financeira para: ****** com o assunto: "Engenheiro(a) de AI & LLM – (Seu Nome)". Na Beegol, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com especialistas, criar soluções de IA que impactam milhões de usuários de redes e crescer junto com a nossa equipe.

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!

  • Strong commitment to safety, including following established ERM Health and Safety protocols.
  • Ability to succeed in a consulting pace, handling multiple project assignments, and maintaining flexibility, while meeting strict deadlines.

ABOUT ERM

Environmental Resources Management (ERM) is a leading global provider of environmental, health, safety, risk, social consulting services and sustainability related services. We have more than 160 offices in over 40 countries and territories employing more than 5,000 people who work on projects around the world. ERM is committed to providing a service that is consistent, professional and of the highest quality to create value for our clients. We have worked with many of the Global Fortune 500 companies delivering innovative solutions for business and selected government clients helping them understand and manage the sustainability challenges that the world is increasingly facing.

For over 50 years we have been working with clients around the world and in diverse industry sectors to help them to understand and manage their environmental, health, safety, risk and social impacts. The key sectors we serve include Oil & Gas, Mining, Power, and Manufacturing, Chemical and Pharmaceutical. All face critical sustainability challenges and our clients in these and many other areas rely on our ability to assist them operate more sustainably which has a positive impact on our planet.

A Environmental Resources Management (ERM) é uma fornecedora líder global de serviços de consultoria ambiental, de saúde, segurança, riscos e sociais, além de serviços relacionados à sustentabilidade. Possuímos mais de 160 escritórios em mais de 40 países e territórios, empregando mais de 5.500 pessoas que trabalham em projetos em todo o mundo. A ERM está comprometida em fornecer um serviço consistente, profissional e da mais alta qualidade para gerar valor para nossos clientes. Trabalhamos muitas das empresas da Fortune 500 Global, fornecendo soluções inovadoras para empresas e clientes governamentais selecionados, ajudando-os a compreender e gerenciar os desafios de sustentabilidade que o mundo enfrenta cada vez mais.

Há mais de 50 anos, trabalhamos com clientes em todo o mundo e em diversos setores da indústria para ajudá-los a compreender e gerenciar seus impactos ambientais, de saúde, segurança, riscos e sociais. Os principais setores que atendemos incluem Petróleo e Gás, Mineração, Energia e Manufatura, Química e Farmacêutica. Todos enfrentam desafios críticos de sustentabilidade e nossos clientes nessas e muitas outras áreas contam com nossa capacidade de ajudá-los a operar de forma mais sustentável, o que gera um impacto positivo em nosso planeta.

Na ERM, sabemos que criar um ambiente de trabalho diverso, equitativo e inclusivo é parte essencial para tornar nossa empresa um ótimo lugar para construir uma carreira.

SOBRE A TOPSHARE E O ECOSSISTEMA CREATONOMY

A Topshare é uma plataforma de tecnologia que atua no coração da creator economy, sendo parte do grupo Creatonomy. Buscamos um profissional para atuar na arquitetura, desenvolvimento, manutenção e aprimoramento da plataforma Topshare, além de participar ativamente na criação da plataforma Creatonomy e em outros projetos estratégicos do grupo. O foco é em soluções escaláveis e de alta performance para todo o ecossistema.

Operamos em um ambiente de trabalho totalmente remoto, valorizando a flexibilidade, a inovação e a excelência técnica.

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Atuar como referência técnica em arquitetura backend, liderando a concepção e a implementação de soluções robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance. O profissional será responsável por garantir a robustez, a escalabilidade e a alta disponibilidade dos sistemas, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em arquiteturas sólidas e eficientes, com foco na stack Node.js (Backend).

RESPONSABILIDADES E ESCOPO DE ATIVIDADES

1. DESENVOLVIMENTO DE BACKEND E ARQUITETURA

Projetar, desenvolver e manter APIs e microsserviços robustos e escaláveis, utilizando a stack Node.js com NestJS (framework obrigatório), para a Topshare e para a plataforma Creatonomy. Isso inclui a modelagem, gestão e otimização de dados em bancos Neo4j (obrigatório) e MongoDB (desejável), garantindo a integridade e a alta disponibilidade do sistema. O profissional deverá contribuir ativamente para a definição da arquitetura de microsserviços e a evolução contínua da stack tecnológica. Será obrigatório o uso de Docker para empacotamento e execução dos serviços em ambientes isolados.

2. DEFINIÇÃO DE PADRÕES E ARQUITETURA

Estabelecer padrões de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de software e boas práticas para o backend. Será responsável por revisar e validar decisões arquiteturais, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e manutenibilidade dos sistemas. Deverá propor e implementar melhorias contínuas na infraestrutura e processos de CI/CD.

3. QUALIDADE DE CÓDIGO E TESTES

Utilizar Git e seguir rigorosamente as boas práticas de Git Flow, realizando pull requests e code reviews de forma contínua para assegurar a qualidade do código. Será responsável por implementar testes unitários com Jest, testes de integração e testes de carga para garantir a resiliência do sistema. Além disso, deverá atuar como referência técnica, compartilhando conhecimento e propondo melhorias na arquitetura e nos processos de CI/CD.

4. DISPONIBILIDADE PARA INCIDENTES CRÍTICOS

O Contratado se compromete a responder e atuar na correção de erros, bugs ou falhas críticas de produção em tempo hábil, fora do horário comercial, quando a indisponibilidade do sistema impactar diretamente a operação ou a receita da Contratante. Esta atuação é inerente à natureza do serviço de alta disponibilidade e não configura controle de jornada.

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Backend, com foco em sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis
  • Proficiência em Node.js
  • Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com NestJS (framework Node.js para desenvolvimento de aplicações escaláveis)
  • Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com testes unitários utilizando Jest
  • Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com Neo4j (Banco de Dados Orientado a Grafos)
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e padrões de design
  • Experiência sólida com Docker e conceitos de conteinerização
  • Conhecimento e aplicação de boas práticas de versionamento com Git
  • Experiência em design e otimização de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL

INFORMAÇÕES DA VAGA

Regime de Contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)

Remuneração: R$ 12.000,00/mês

Local: Remoto

Horário de Trabalho: De segunda a sexta-feira, em horário comercial
